slides.text: How to say *"that won't work"* without sounding negative
Start with the *goal*: "I want this to succeed."
Save this for your next meeting.
slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily

caption:
Start with the goal, name one risk, offer an alternative, ask what they think.
